question: Which of the following places receives rainfall from the Bay of Bengal branch of southwest monsoon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kolkata** receives rainfall from the **Bay of Bengal branch of the southwest monsoon**.
 
• The southwest monsoon splits into two branches: the **Arabian Sea branch** and the **Bay of Bengal branch**.
 
• The Bay of Bengal branch moves over the Bay of Bengal, hits the eastern coast of India, and brings heavy rainfall to the northeastern states and the eastern parts of the country, including Kolkata.
 
• This branch is responsible for significant rainfall in West Bengal, Odisha, and northeastern states, contributing to the overall monsoon season in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **southwest monsoon** is a major climatic phenomenon in India, occurring from June to September.
 
• The monsoon season is crucial for the **agricultural sector** in India, which relies heavily on the rainfall for crop cultivation.
 
• The onset and intensity of the monsoon are monitored by the **India Meteorological Department (IMD)**.
 
• In addition to Kolkata, other regions like **Assam, Meghalaya, and Tripura** also receive substantial rainfall from the Bay of Bengal branch.
 
• The monsoon plays a vital role in replenishing water resources, including rivers, lakes, and groundwater, across the country.
